_about: How a character learns what a hide, tannin, oil, wax, thread or dye does
(docs/leatherworking-revamp-plan.md §16; contracts §1 lane F). Read by rules/knowledge.py
beside herb-lore.json, smithing-lore.json and alchemy-lore.json, whose shape this mirrors,
so one module answers every craft. Words, prices and times only: every number is the
rules' own, so no model ever authors one, and every one can be tuned in play.
Before this file (leather lane F, 2026-10-08) every leather material answered to the
SMITH's rows (knowledge.craft_of): a blacksmith taught deer hide, a guildhall shelved it,
and grading a hide was the forge's assay, a tenth of a bar compared against every known
material of kind `hide`. Prices are in copper (Core Rulebook Table 6-1); a lesson is
priced as a healer's and a smith's are, a skilled hireling's hour.

grade._scrap: Plan §16: Grade 'costs a scrap (a quarter unit, or an offcut from any earlier step)'. Hides track quarter units (contracts §4.1); a tannin, oil, wax, thread or dye loses a quarter measure, the forge's sliver in leather units.
grade._comparison: Plan §16: -1 DC for each known hide of the same CREATURE TYPE, at most -4: the forge's touchstone rule (smithing-lore.json `assay`) keyed on type rather than kind. A tannin, oil, wax, thread or dye keeps the forge's by-kind comparison (knowledge._comparison_key).
grade._danger: None. The owner, 2026-10-08 (open point 10): 'dangerous hides should not bite they should force another round of checks to avoid poison, acid or elemental dmg while skinning.' A dangerous body is the harvest's second check, never Grade's (knowledge.danger_of).

study._dc: 10 + 5 per rarity band, as herbs, metals and reagents: Grade's DC before comparison (plan §16, 'a Craft roll at the material's DC').

teacher._works: Occupation ids (content/people/occupations.json) whose people know hides: the occupations tagged `leather` (plan §16, 'a keeper with the leather occupation tag'); today that is the tanner alone, whose match words already take leatherworker, cobbler and saddler. The words name the trade when no population record carries one. A word must stand alone: 'skinner' never matches inside another word.
teacher._teaches: Properties taught per lesson by attitude step (rules/attitude.py), the herb teacher's rows: below indifferent they refuse in words.

library._common: What the world writes down about hides: the benefits of common and uncommon ones. A rare hide's secrets and every drawback stay unwritten, as for herbs and metals.

manual._mastery: Plan §17.3: 'an unread leatherworking manual (+5 once)', worldclass.MANUAL_MP.
